title: The Beginning of Months
text: This month is the beginning of months for you; it shall be the first month of your year.

title: A Lamb for Each Household
text: … each man must select a lamb for his family, one per household.

title: An Unblemished Lamb
text: Your lamb must be an unblemished year-old male …

title: Roasted over the Fire
text: They are to eat the meat that night, roasted over the fire, along with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

title: Bitter Herbs
text: … along with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

title: Eat in Haste
text: You are to eat in haste; it is the LORD’s Passover.

title: Blood on the Doorframe
text: They are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes …

title: I Will Pass Over You
text: … when I see the blood, I will pass over you.

title: Until Morning
text: None of you shall go out the door of his house until morning.

title: At Midnight
text: Now at midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn male in the land of Egypt …

title: Loud Wailing
text: … there was loud wailing in Egypt; for there was no house without someone dead.

title: Leave My People
text: Get up, leave my people, both you and the Israelites!

title: A Memorial
text: And this day will be a memorial for you …

title: Silver, Gold and Clothing
text: … asked the Egyptians for articles of silver and gold, and for clothing.

title: 600,000 on Foot
text: The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Succoth with about 600,000 men on foot, besides women and children.

title: What Does This Service Mean?
text: When your children ask you, ‘What does this service mean to you?’

title: Our Passover Lamb
text: For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.

title: Unleavened Bread
text: Since their dough had no leaven, the people baked what they had brought out of Egypt into unleavened loaves.

title: The Firstborn
text: The blood on the houses where you are staying will be a sign; when I see the blood, I will pass over you.

title: Your Children Will Ask
text: When your children ask you, ‘What does this service mean to you?’

title: Share with a Neighbor
text: If the household is too small for a whole lamb, they are to share with the nearest neighbor …

title: A New Year
text: This month is the beginning of months for you; it shall be the first month of your year.
